derivation:
by
  intro U s hs
  simpa [Subfunctor.sheafify, GrothendieckTopology.Covers] using J.arrow_max (𝟙 _) (G.sieveOfSection s) (by simpa using hs)
explanation: Apply arrow_max to the identity arrow and G.sieveOfSection s. Identity membership simplifies to hs, and covering the identity simplifies to membership in G.sheafify J. The candidate's proof is independent of the target.
